text: Come in, come in. Not many people knock on this door asking about the old days anymore. Sit down, friend.

choices.text: Thank you. Who am I speaking to?
I'd like to ask you about your life.

text: Major Malcolm Wheeler-Nicholson, formerly of the United States Cavalry. These days, mostly a writer, and a man with a long memory.
I started something once that grew far bigger than me. Other men's names ended up on it. A fellow gets used to that, mostly.

choices.text: I'd like to hear your side of it.

text: Ask what you like. I have answered harder questions in front of a court-martial.

choices.text: Tell me about your time in the Army.
How did you come to write for the pulps?
How did you start publishing comics?
What do you make of Superman and Batman now?
I think that's all I wanted to ask.
